group_note: 终极地狱2008完整版 (REVIVE OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM 1999.11.13, CDS), same Doing-lineage family as this session's already-processed 'hell' lib -- shares the exact same master.lpc/logind.lpc/named.lpc/versiond.lpc structure almost line-for-line. WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() (str[i..i+1] byte-pair check with 176-247/161-254 ranges) rewritten to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff; check_legal_name()'s matching maxlen-not-halved bound fixed to maxlen/2 with a 1-char minimum (was 2). (2) master.lpc (adm/single/master.lpc) valid_read()/valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' guard -- added to both. (3) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at 12 call sites (kungfu/skill/*.lpc suck/tan/zhua/hua files, clone/user/user.lpc, d/city/npc/guidao.lpc, cmds/std/ansuan.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc). (4) A missing log/nosave/ directory caused logon()'s very first log_file() call to throw 'Wrong permissions for opening file /log/nosave/logon' and disconnect every connecting user outright ('new_conn_handler: logon() ... has failed') -- created the directory, matching the same class of bug found in yxxcii but here it was boot-blocking rather than cosmetic. (5) The combined surname+name minimum-length check in get_name() (strlen(fname)<4, byte-doubled) and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() sliding-window near-name dedup (minimum 2->1, window slices name[i..i+3]/name[i..i+5] -> name[i..i+1]/name[i..i+2], loop bound l-4 -> l-2, gate i+6<=l -> i+3<=l) both fixed to the halved per-codepoint bounds, matching the hell-family precedent exactly -- without this, single-character surnames and any two-character full name were rejected as 'too short'. (6) versiond.lpc's in_server() (called via logind.lpc's direct, unguarded VERSION_D->is_version_ok()/query_temp() calls in logon(), so it compiles on the very first connection even though it's not in adm/etc/preload) had the same real un-gutted socket_create()/socket_bind() calls as hell's versiond.lpc -- gutted all 13 socket-touching functions (in_server, connect_server, clear_syn_info's socket_close loop, send_command, send_client_pending_msg, syn_finish's socket_close, in_listen_callback, in_write_callback, in_close_callback, cmd_close, send_pending_msg, send_result, remove_connection's socket_close) to no-ops/notify_fail per AGENTS.md §7.52, near-identical to the hell fix. adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are both dormant (commented out of adm/etc/preload, only guarded wizard-command callers) and were left untouched. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist.
